Côte de la Croix de la Liberation

story: The wind split the peloton immediately after the start, with a 40-rider leading echelon forming without white jersey Kevin Vauquelin. A crash in the front later forced Juan Ayuso and Brandon McNulty to abandon and split the leaders, leaving seven riders clear, including five from Red Bull–BORA–hansgrohe and Jonas Vingegaard. Red Bull kept the tempo high, until Vingegaard attacked inside the final kilometre to take victory.
